set.body:
Make plan_relation(study, model, effect_map, observation_model) the estimand-bearing first-moment plan and estimate(plan) the neural-data-touching execution verb.

A fixed observation model grants a fixed-linear extractor and the admitted residual, effect-covariance, and residual-df capabilities. Learned AR or GLS models carry training provenance and weaker capabilities.

Acceptance: estimate(plan) emits the existing effect_relation_fit contract; lm_relation_fit becomes a compatibility adapter; plan identity is unchanged by QR versus SVD, block versus whole execution, or other numerical routes; receipts distinguish routes; fit identity binds the plan, source revisions, realized row lineage, and design receipt; numerical routes agree to declared tolerance.
set.title: Phase 3: Implement plan_relation, observation models, receipts, and estimate compatibility
